name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank direct-DP incast pair
notes: Healthy 1:1 rail fabric: steady-state DP fits, congestion is purely episodic (microburst incast plus ECMP collisions). Near-zero relief is expected and calibrates the degraded conditions.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank burst-source 0 pair
notes: Negative control of the burst-source sweep: no microburst, so no congestion gate. Relief here should be near zero.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank burst-source 2 pair
notes: Burst-source sweep point: 2 asymmetric senders at one receiver downlink on the healthy 1:1 fabric.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank burst-source 4 pair
notes: Burst-source sweep point: 4 asymmetric senders at one receiver downlink on the healthy 1:1 fabric.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank CLR-step burst pair
notes: Burst-timing contrast: the burst fires at step 1, which the schedule holds at probability 1.0 so it is CLR under every seed. The policy must shed almost nothing here; contrast with the step-18 arm is the directional signature of phase-awareness.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank 7-incast p_high 0.2 pair
notes: Dose sensitivity: does doubling p_high (0.1 -> 0.2) move relief at the 7-source incast point where relief collapsed to 0.75% makespan? Screening point of the p_high dose grid (10-60%) at seed 314159265, matching the existing burst-sweep origin so the p_high=0.1 runs need no rerun. Single seed: read makespan / span-p99 direction and trim counters only, no tail claims. Retire or replicate with seeds once the dose question is answered.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank 7-incast p_high 0.4 pair
notes: Dose curvature: does relief keep scaling from 0.2 to 0.4 or saturate, locating the knee on a log-dose axis? Screening point of the p_high dose grid (10-60%) at seed 314159265, matching the existing burst-sweep origin so the p_high=0.1 runs need no rerun. Single seed: read makespan / span-p99 direction and trim counters only, no tail claims. Retire or replicate with seeds once the dose question is answered.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank 7-incast p_high 0.6 pair
notes: Dose ceiling: if even fixed-high at 0.6 buys no relief at 7 sources, the congestion is burst-dominated fabric saturation and no shedding dose can restore relief - falsifies the sweet-spot-as-dose hypothesis. Screening point of the p_high dose grid (10-60%) at seed 314159265, matching the existing burst-sweep origin so the p_high=0.1 runs need no rerun. Single seed: read makespan / span-p99 direction and trim counters only, no tail claims. Retire or replicate with seeds once the dose question is answered.

name: Llama 3 70B 32-rank burst-4 p_high 0.4 pair
notes: Dose x burst interaction: at the same 0.4 dose, does burst-4 keep its advantage over 7-incast (sweet spot is a fabric property) or does 7-incast catch up (sweet spot was an artifact of the 0.1 dose)? Screening point of the p_high dose grid (10-60%) at seed 314159265, matching the existing burst-sweep origin so the p_high=0.1 runs need no rerun. Single seed: read makespan / span-p99 direction and trim counters only, no tail claims. Retire or replicate with seeds once the dose question is answered.

name: Llama 3 70B 64-rank pp2 non-sheddable control pair
notes: pp=2 puts non-sheddable pipeline activations on the degraded knee fabric alongside sheddable DP gradients. The policy's eligibility is dp_all_reduce_only, so PP flow completion must stay intact while DP is relieved.

name: Llama 3 70B 64-rank fan-in direct2 pair
notes: Degraded 1:1 sweep point and the completion canary: judge the matrix by this arm first, since it is the window that collapsed on the designed-2:1 fabric.

name: Llama 3 70B 64-rank fan-in direct4 pair
notes: Degraded 1:1 (two failed spines, 4:3 live) concurrency sweep point.

name: Llama 3 70B 64-rank fan-in direct pair
notes: Degraded 1:1 (two failed spines, 4:3 live) concurrency sweep point at the unwindowed maximum.

name: Llama 3 70B 64-rank selective-repair 2:1 canary pair
notes: Selective retransmission on the designed-2:1 fabric that collapsed go-back-N: trims repair exactly the reported range and the receiver accepts out-of-order payload. If this pair completes, sustained oversubscription returns as a swept axis; its contrast with the go-back-N sweep is itself a paper finding.

name: Historical Phase-1 64-rank native reference run
notes: Lossless-at-scale sentinel, structural single run behind the manual structural dispatch: the 2026-08-07 run measured 46% of its 5.999M queue pairs in 3h37m of simulator wall clock, a ~7.8 h full run that no six-hour hosted job can hold on any budget split. Its zero-recovery verification therefore runs on demand, not per push.

name: 100B 256-card Clos structural evaluation
notes: Opt-in workload characterization on a lossless fabric; never a policy comparison.

name: 100B 256-card Ring structural evaluation
notes: Opt-in physical Clos-versus-ring characterization; never a policy comparison.

name: Regime map 64-rank none direct2 2to1
notes: Regime map point: one characterization arm, no comparison. Both selection probabilities sit at the strict bound, so this single run.py invocation is exactly the fixed-low arm a comparison would have produced. The map tests H1 (sustained oversubscription with fan-in), H2 (burst persistence) and H3 (congestion control on) from docs/agents/next-steps-after-run-117.md at once, under selective repair only. Pre-registered estimands: W, burst drain over its serialization floor, DP span at the burst and aftermath steps, trimmed-to-untrimmed DP flow ratio, RTO count, rate-cut count. Budget mirrors the 64-rank sr2x canary, which ran in about 11 h.

name: Recovery-domain flagship comparison (seed 31415926)
notes: Four matched arms per seed: fixed-low, phase-aware admission, recovery domain at the same budget, and fixed-high. The estimands are W', forgiven bytes, and the DP spans at the burst and aftermath steps. Gated, not always-on: the decisive wave belongs at the regime map's operating point, and until the map runs this profile is a mechanism check rather than a result.

name: Recovery-domain no-incast control
notes: Negative control of the recovery domain: selective repair and ftd trimming on a fabric with no incast. Nothing should be forgiven because nothing should be trimmed, so a nonzero forgiven count here is an implementation error, not a result.
